create_ddp_model: create a DistributedDataParallel model with optional fp16 compression hooks for multi-GPU inference
build_model: build the UniVLG model architecture from a detectron2 config and load pretrained weights via DetectionCheckpointer
run_evaluation: run standalone 3D object grounding evaluation on point cloud data with language captions and bounding box predictions
visualize_pc_masks_and_bbox: visualize a 3D point cloud with predicted masks and bounding boxes saved to a timestamped directory
process_lang_data: process language captions into tokenized inputs with positive token maps for grounding tasks
